title: Resonance and isomerism in benzene
notes: **Fact.** Structural: chain, position, functional, metamerism, tautomerism. Same formula, different connectivity.
**Fact.** Geometrical (cis/trans or E/Z): restricted rotation (double bond / ring) + two different groups on each end.
**Fact.** Optical: chiral centre (4 different groups); d/l (+/− enantiomers; meso = optically inactive despite chiral centres).
